page_or_component: Directory page > Web Directory link list
wcag_reference: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value; 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context)
evidence: Rendered page content shows every Web Directory link with a leftover loading placeholder inside its name, e.g. "Loading... Apex Bodies", "Loading... Legislature", "Loading... Judiciary" (7 links). Source: https://www.india.gov.in/directory, inspected 11 Oct 2026.
user_impact: Screen reader users hear 'Loading' before every link name and may think content is still loading; voice-control users cannot say the visible name to activate the link.
recommended_fix: Move the loading indicator out of the link's accessible name (aria-hidden or a sibling element) and remove it once data has loaded.

wcag_reference: 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context); 2.4.9 Link Purpose (Link Only)
evidence: Six or more links have the identical visible text "Explore" (Who's Who, Contact Directory, Web Directory, Helpline Numbers, Public Utilities). Purpose is only added through title attributes such as title="Explore whos who", which many assistive technologies do not announce.
user_impact: Screen reader users who list links by name get a list of identical 'Explore' entries and cannot tell destinations apart; touch users with cognitive disabilities get no destination cue.
recommended_fix: Use unique link text (e.g. "Explore Who's Who") or add visually hidden text / aria-label that starts with the visible text.

wcag_reference: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships; 2.4.6 Headings and Labels
evidence: Four consecutive headings all read "Toggle FAQ Section" and no question or answer text appears under them in the rendered content.
user_impact: Heading navigation gives four identical headings that describe an action, not the topic; users cannot tell which FAQ they are opening or whether content exists.
recommended_fix: Make each heading the actual FAQ question and use a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls inside the heading for the toggle.

evidence: Decorative vector graphics carry meaningless alt text: "Green Vector Image" (x2), "left-vector2", "left-vector3", "Directorybg". Image file names also contain spaces ("Rectangle 4812.svg").
user_impact: Screen reader users hear file-name style noise between content; it adds listening effort without adding information.
recommended_fix: Set alt="" (or use CSS backgrounds) for decorative images and rename assets without spaces.

evidence: Footer social links use the raw URL as link text: [https://www.facebook.com/nationalportalofindia] and [https://x.com/indiagovin]; the title attributes ("Find us on Facebook", "Find us on X") are the only readable names.
user_impact: Screen readers read a long URL character by character; users on slow speech rates lose time and may not recognise the destination.
recommended_fix: Use link text or aria-label "National Portal of India on Facebook" / "... on X" and hide the icon with aria-hidden.
